statusDetail: Atomic audit completed across 58/58 checks. The requested host redirects via moviesda32.com to moviesda33.com; both requested-origin and final-host behaviour were included.

paths.description: Entry page and global template: purpose, navigation, preferences, performance, privacy, crawler rendering, desktop/mobile layout.
Latest-updates listing archetype, representing category/list pages and content scanning.
Movie detail and resolution-selection journey, representing title/detail pages.
One additional step in the primary download journey, stopping at resolution choices without downloading third-party/copyrighted media.
Movie-request form archetype, including labels and native invalid-input recovery.
Unknown-route recovery test; exposes the site’s soft-404 redirect behaviour.

findings.summary: No user-preference dark theme
findings.evidence: Dark and default captures are identical and CSS has no color-scheme support.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for every surface, text, border, and browser UI color.

findings.summary: Contrast preferences are ignored
findings.evidence: No prefers-contrast/forced-colors adaptation exists, while default colors already include WCAG failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast treatments that preserve text/control visibility, and repair the default contrast tokens.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no real view-transition at-rule or named transition across this multi-page flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } with a reduced-motion override, then progressively name stable shared elements where useful.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll context
findings.evidence: The mobile home is 4,253px tall but has no progress, sticky context, or scroll-state response.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight semantic progress/current-section affordance or a compact scroll-responsive header without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Multi-step navigation lacks orientation cues
findings.evidence: Listing and detail pages have neither breadcrumbs nor route transition cues.
findings.suggestedFix: Add crawlable breadcrumbs/current-step context and preserve attention/focus at the new page heading after navigation.

findings.summary: Repeated header chrome dominates the first viewport
findings.evidence: At 360px, about 340px of the first 800px is branding, promotional text, and search before content.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse repeated promotion, keep one concise identity line, and bring each page’s primary heading/action into the first viewport.

findings.summary: Many links have undersized touch targets
findings.evidence: The probe measured numerous prominent links at only 17px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Give row links or their containers a minimum 44px logical block size with adequate spacing while retaining visible :focus-visible treatment.

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently become an unrelated menu
findings.evidence: A nonexistent path redirects to /movies.php and returns HTTP 200/index-follow with no error state.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 and show a clear not-found message with search, home, and relevant category recovery actions.

findings.summary: LCP is outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.3s LCP/FCP and the trace measured 3.04s LCP.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect latency, reduce render-blocking font/style work, and keep critical content/system fonts immediately paintable.

findings.summary: Redirect and font chains delay first content
findings.evidence: moviesda31.com redirects through moviesda32.com to moviesda33.com; CSS then @imports Google Fonts.
findings.suggestedFix: Point public URLs directly at one canonical host, replace CSS @import with non-blocking/preconnected font delivery or system fonts, and keep critical CSS shallow.

findings.summary: Analytics dominates script cost
findings.evidence: Tag Manager is 166KB and Lighthouse estimates 68KiB unused JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unnecessary tags, load analytics only after an appropriate consent/value decision, or replace it with a minimal first-party measurement path.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail contrast minimums
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports six failures, including 2.7:1 white text on the cyan section style.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken blue/cyan surfaces or use dark foreground text until normal text reaches at least 4.5:1, and test all semantic color tokens.

findings.summary: Most templates have no page heading
findings.evidence: Listing, detail, request, and recovery templates contain no h1; section labels are divs.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one descriptive h1 per page and semantic h2/h3 structure inside main; retain the existing visible focus outline and move focus sensibly after navigation.

findings.summary: Mobile reflow succeeds but targets remain too small
findings.evidence: No horizontal overflow occurs, but links are frequently only 17px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target block size/spacing to at least 44 CSS pixels where practical and verify at 200% zoom and 320–360px reflow.

findings.summary: Cache policy prevents back/forward restoration
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache blockers caused by Cache-Control: no-store on the document/request.
findings.suggestedFix: Use no-store only for genuinely sensitive responses; allow public catalogue pages to be cached and restored safely.

findings.summary: Prominent links do not lead where they claim
findings.evidence: Telegram uses href="#" and Disclaimer points to the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination URLs for both links or render non-actions as text; ensure every labelled navigation control has a descriptive crawlable href.

findings.summary: Canonical and error indexing signals conflict
findings.evidence: No canonical exists, the public origin changes twice, and missing paths become indexable 200 pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Choose one host, redirect once, emit self-referencing canonicals, and return 404/noindex for missing resources while keeping sitemap and OG URLs aligned.

findings.summary: Movie detail entities lack structured data
findings.evidence: All sampled pages have zero JSON-LD despite movie-specific visible entities.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org Movie/BreadcrumbList JSON-LD matching visible title, release information, and canonical URL; validate it.

findings.summary: Session and analytics cookies lack baseline protection
findings.evidence: CSP/HSTS/nosniff are absent; four cookies lack Secure and SameSite, and PHPSESSID lacks HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly (for session), and SameSite=Lax/Strict as appropriate; deploy HSTS, CSP, and nosniff over the final HTTPS host.

findings.summary: Tracking footprint is disproportionate
findings.evidence: Seven third-party origins include Google trackers and an opaque ad script; nearly all transferred bytes are classified third-party from the requested origin.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the opaque script, minimise analytics, load optional measurement only with a justified privacy basis, and document each retained third party.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: No HSTS, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP, or nosniff header was returned.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP (including frame-ancestors), HSTS after HTTPS verification, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: HTTP failure state is replaced with misleading success
findings.evidence: The missing-path test returns generic successful content instead of an actionable error.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the failing URL with 404 semantics and render a resilient server-side recovery page with clear next actions.

findings.summary: Control labels do not match outcomes
findings.evidence: Telegram is a dead # link and Disclaimer unexpectedly returns home.
findings.suggestedFix: Make each labelled action truthful: supply the real channel/disclaimer destinations or remove the actionable styling and wording.

findings.summary: Background measurement outweighs the useful page code
findings.evidence: Tag Manager accounts for 166KB on an otherwise tiny document and an opaque script is also loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate unused tags and third-party background work; prefer a small deferred first-party measurement endpoint if measurement is necessary.

findings.summary: Third-party byte budget is not proportionate
findings.evidence: 12/13 requests and 208.7KB/209.1KB are third-party from the requested origin, driven by analytics and fonts rather than content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, self-host or drop the font, remove nonessential scripts, and defer retained third parties until they provide user value.

taskList.title: Harden headers, cookies, and third-party privacy
Restore truthful HTTP, canonical, and recovery semantics
Fix contrast, headings, and touch targets
Remove redirect, font, analytics, and unused-script delay
Reduce repeated header chrome and add page orientation
